<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Jordan 2026-09-02: agents write `pij-rs send --from <self> --to <peer> --msg-id "$(uuidgen)" --body '…'` on every call — wasteful, and the only rs send form takes the body as a literal shell argument. Also (antelope): `export PIJ_SESSION_ID` is a no-op for pane-bound seats because fresh shell commands do not retain it, so `pij-rs inbox` fails with no seat after a successful adopt; and the rs pointer text says `run: pij inbox` which is the unrouted bare legacy verb. Rows: req-0041 (+ req-0032 silent usage on missing --msg-id, req-0039(e) body-file as a legacy-shutdown precondition). The shimmed `pij send <id> <text>` already derives sender by pane and mints the id (crates/daemon/src/http/shim.rs, identity::resolve_seat) — the raw CLI must reach parity. Ruling: weasel 2026-09-02 — every pane-bound harness, including omp/pi, derives identity from the pane; `export PIJ_SESSION_ID` advice is paneless-only because an asserted id must never outrank the observable pane.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- G1 Identity: every pij-rs verb that needs the acting seat sends every available identity input to the daemon; an observable pane ($TMUX_PANE against /v1/seats) is authoritative, PIJ_SESSION_ID is used when no pane exists, disagreement is refused by name, and absence of both produces a named refusal.
- G2 send: --from optional (derived), --msg-id optional (minted as a UUIDv7/ULID by the CLI, echoed in the receipt), --body OR --body-file <path> OR --body-file - (stdin); missing all three = refusal naming the options; a body that starts with `-` is never parsed as a flag.
- G3 Misuse is loud: any missing required input prints a one-line refusal and exits non-zero; usage text is never printed on a failed send (req-0032).
- G4 Pointer/notice text: the daemon's `message waiting` line says `pij inbox check` (routed) not bare `pij inbox`; adopt output for every pane-bound harness, including claude/copilot/codex/omp/pi, says the pane resolves identity and never instructs `export PIJ_SESSION_ID`; export advice is paneless-only.
- G5 Help shows the short form first: `pij-rs send --to <id> --body '…'` and `pij-rs send --to <id> --body-file -`.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No change to the shim (`pij send`) semantics.
- No pane-typing/delivery changes (s122).
- No new verbs.
